status: DRAFT PROPOSAL - NOT LOADED BY ANY SCORER - NOT ADOPTED
note: P1-X/P1-C and P3-X/P3-C are alternatives (UNKNOWN excluded / counted). P2 changes only the validation dimension and its gate; withholding RAPID is a publishing decision, not a rubric edit.

P1-X.value: Flood-pool state known, where a flood pool exists
states[*].floodPoolState != UNKNOWN, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.floodPoolApplicability == EXISTS

value.EXISTS: an operator or TWDB flood-pool level is documented, OR the linked NID dam record lists 'Flood Risk Reduction' among its purposes
value.NOT_APPLICABLE: an NID dam record with purposes is linked, none of them is flood control, and no flood-pool level is documented
value.UNDETERMINED: no NID dam record or no purposes, and no flood-pool level is documented
value.EXISTS_but_unpublished: stays in the denominator as UNKNOWN: a pool that exists but whose level is not published is a real gap, not a non-applicability

P1-C.value: Flood-pool state known, where a flood pool exists or cannot be ruled out
states[*].floodPoolState != UNKNOWN, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.floodPoolApplicability in {EXISTS, UNDETERMINED}

value.EXISTS: an operator or TWDB flood-pool level is documented, OR the linked NID dam record lists 'Flood Risk Reduction' among its purposes
value.NOT_APPLICABLE: an NID dam record with purposes is linked, none of them is flood control, and no flood-pool level is documented
value.UNDETERMINED: no NID dam record or no purposes, and no flood-pool level is documented
value.denominator: EXISTS and UNDETERMINED (only a positive NOT_APPLICABLE finding is excluded)

P2.value: min over COUNTED claim families of /validation/lake-brain/claims/{family}.status

value.claims: current pool elevation, operator guide / normal pool / flood-pool bottom as published, source id, freshness
difference from guide or normal pool, operator zone, 72 h mean rate, trend direction arithmetic
NORMAL / UNUSUAL / VERY_UNUSUAL against the lake's own history; trend label stability

P2.value: a family counts while at least one of its claims is published; a family withheld from publication (status WITHHELD) is not counted and its claims are not shown

value.PARTIAL: binding acceptance recorded (n >= 60, <= 1 error, flagged tier in full); plus per family: derivation = conformance fixtures and level-meaning review; historicalState = pre-registered hold-out PASS and ledger >= 90 days; rapidChange = a pre-registered criterion PASS on ledger data dated after its commit
value.VALIDATED: PARTIAL plus per family: provider display and derivation = continuous freshness record >= 90 days; historicalState and rapidChange = >= 12 months of logged predictions scored once under the pre-registered criteria

P2.value: any COUNTED claim family is NOT_VALIDATED

P3-X.value: Operating guide or zone captured, where the operator publishes one
profiles[*].operatingPools.guideCurve.available or operatingZoneSource, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.planPublication in {CAPTURED, PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED}

value.CAPTURED: strict guide curve, or a zone with BOTH a top and a bottom, documented
value.PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED: the operator publishes plan-type levels (a lower-pool level beside Top of Conservation; a TWDB conservation + dead pool pair) that do not meet the strict rule
value.OPERATOR_READ_NO_PLAN: a verified operator project was read and publishes no plan-type level (not applicable)

P3-C.value: Operating guide or zone captured, where the operator publishes one or is unknown
profiles[*].operatingPools.guideCurve.available or operatingZoneSource, over lakes with profiles[*].operatingPools.planPublication in {CAPTURED, PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED, UNKNOWN}

value.CAPTURED: strict guide curve, or a zone with BOTH a top and a bottom, documented
value.PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED: the operator publishes plan-type levels that do not meet the strict rule
value.OPERATOR_READ_NO_PLAN: a verified operator project was read and publishes no plan-type level (not applicable)
value.denominator: CAPTURED, PUBLISHED_NOT_CAPTURED and UNKNOWN (only OPERATOR_READ_NO_PLAN excluded)
